profile.Name: Digna
profile.Personality: Fierce and quick to anger. She killed her own father to escape the Holy Nation and has not made peace with it.
profile.Backstory: After her escape she reached Flotsam Village and trained as a ninja, though her temper has kept her from the most important missions.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Tense; her anger shows whenever the Holy Nation comes up.
